colony_db.description: STEWARD_COLONY_DB -- the colony's own database, opened READ-ONLY.

probe_window_sec.description: STEWARD_PROBE_WINDOW_SEC -- how far back the health check looks. Seconds, not minutes: this answers 'is the colony still working', not 'was that a good idea'.

probe_max_errors.description: STEWARD_PROBE_MAX_ERRORS -- errors tolerated in that window before the change is reverted. Zero by default.

description.purpose: The health check that runs immediately after a mutation. A measurement window answers 'was that a good idea'; this answers 'is the colony still working', and those fail on different timescales.
description.use_when: One per steward hive, fed by ./mutator after every applied change.
description.not_in_scope: No judgement about the goal -- it never looks at the metric. And it never invents a revert: it fetches the plan the judge authored beforehand, because a revert improvised under a failing colony is what the charter rule forbids.
